propositions: Cancelled ACLI link delete commands are miscounted as applied links because the no-print exception handler increments links_applied for all CalledProcessError, silently inflating success reports.
Missing --yes flag on both link create and link delete subcommands causes confirmation prompts to read EOF and fail deterministically with 'command cancelled' every pass, never succeeding.
The silent-noop canary cannot detect this divergence because links_applied is fabricated to equal computed, defeating the computed > 0 and applied == 0 test condition.
Idempotent failures (404, 409, does-not-exist, not-found markers) must be narrowly matched against both stderr and stdout, not stderr alone, to avoid false alarms on concurrent-removal races.
A new links_failed counter must track non-idempotent failures separately and be included in batch_outcome reporting to restore auditability of divergence.
